description: On the bed in front of you there’s a white plastic bench- or chair-like frame with a couple of small white block pieces lying nearby, and a pink pillow against the headboard. The left hand steadies the frame at its base as the right hand reaches in from the right, pinches a small white rectangular block, lowers it into the top slot between the two upright rails, nudges it to align, and then releases while the left hand keeps the frame from shifting.
